name: Shield
soul: The soul of someone who steps in front. It is not courage. They simply cannot watch it land on someone else.
spark: The mote keeps between you and the door. Whichever door.

hybrid.text: It is in the way before you have decided there is anything to be in the way of.

newFeatures.label: a point in the middle of the shield

settled.name: Buckler
settled.text: A fist-sized buckler with a dent you did not put there. It gets between you and things, including, twice, your dinner.
settled.sign: A dented round of iron no bigger than a plate, with a grip worn bright.
settled.habit: It moves to whichever side of you the door is on.

paths.name: Wall-shield
paths.of: one who, having said no, has finished speaking
paths.text: It learned from you that the best place to be is the place that does not move.
paths.sign: It has grown as tall as your chin, and stands on its own rim.
paths.habit: It stands exactly where you put it down. You have tested this over a whole afternoon.

prongs.name: Battered Shield
prongs.of: one who takes every blow that got past as their own failing
prongs.text: Some blows get past it and reach you. It has taken that personally.
prongs.sign: Dents all over, each one hammered back out and still showing.
prongs.habit: It turns its worst dent to the wall when visitors come.

finishes.name: Shield-biter
finishes.of: one who has started biting back
finishes.text: Its rim has grown teeth. What hits you is held by the limb that did it, and you take your turn at leisure.
finishes.sign: Its rim has grown teeth, and it holds them a little open.
finishes.habit: It closes on anything pushed at it: a broom, a finger, an offered hand.

finishes.name: Lone Round
finishes.of: one who refuses help and has learned to manage
finishes.text: A small round shield for one person a long way out. It is also the plate you eat off, and it does not mind.
finishes.sign: Small again, and round, with a rim worn smooth by one hand.
finishes.habit: At supper it lies flat and lets you eat off it. It keeps the grit out of the stew.

prongs.name: Spiked Boss
prongs.of: one who, pushed, pushes back harder
prongs.text: It has grown a point in the middle and puts it where your Pattern ends.
prongs.sign: A point grown from the middle, a hand long, and bright at the tip.
prongs.habit: It leans, very slightly, toward whoever is talking loudest.

finishes.name: Ram's Head
finishes.of: one who goes through, not round
finishes.text: At the end of your chain it goes through whatever is in front, door or beast. It prefers doors, which complain less.
finishes.sign: Two curled horns have grown either side of the boss.
finishes.habit: It rests its boss against closed doors and waits, with meaning.

finishes.name: The Last Word
finishes.of: one who is still there when the other has tired
finishes.text: It ends arguments by walking forward. Nothing has yet been stubborn enough to still be standing there.
finishes.sign: Its face is worn flat and bright from being walked into things.
finishes.habit: It moves forward a finger's width whenever nobody is looking. By evening it is across the room.

prongs.name: Mirror-shield
prongs.of: one who shows people what they are doing
prongs.text: Polished on the beat until it shows the blow coming. You have both got vain about it.
prongs.sign: A face polished until it shows the room, a little bent.
prongs.habit: It turns to show you yourself when you are about to say something you will regret.

finishes.name: The Turned Blow
finishes.of: one who hands an insult back, improved
finishes.text: What strikes it on the beat gets its own blow back, a little improved.
finishes.sign: The polish has a ripple in it that moves when it is struck.
finishes.habit: It catches thrown things, a ball, a crust, and sends them back harder.

finishes.name: Scrying Face
finishes.of: one who sees the quarrel a breath before it starts
finishes.text: Its face shows what is about to happen in the room, a breath early and a little warped at the edges.
finishes.sign: The room in its face is a moment ahead of the room.
finishes.habit: It watches the door in its own reflection, and tilts when someone is about to come in.

paths.name: Gate-shield
paths.of: one who belongs to a place and will not see it fall
paths.text: It learned from you that some ground is home, that home has a door, and that somebody has to be the door.
paths.sign: It is door-shaped now, with a bar across its back.
paths.habit: It stands in the doorway of wherever you are staying, facing out.

prongs.name: Tower Shield
prongs.of: one for whom an instruction is the end of the discussion
prongs.text: It has grown taller than you are and has a foot to stand on. Told to hold, it considers the matter closed.
prongs.sign: Taller than you, with a foot it stands on.
prongs.habit: It takes the same spot every night, to the inch. There is a mark on the floor.

finishes.name: Post-wall
finishes.of: one counted on the roster as part of the building
finishes.text: At a post it sets itself in the gap of the palisade, and the roster counts it as a section of wall.
finishes.sign: It is the grey of palisade timber and has a number painted on it.
finishes.habit: It stands in gaps: between two chairs, in a missing fence board, in a queue.

finishes.name: Gatehouse
finishes.of: one whose loyalty has a door in it, and a short list
finishes.text: The party fights from behind it and goes out through it. It opens for them and for no one else.
finishes.sign: A small wicket in its face that it opens to look through.
finishes.habit: It swings aside for people it knows before they have reached it.

prongs.name: Ward-bearer
prongs.of: one who carries the rule of the house so that others have their hands free
prongs.text: It carries your ward on its face so you have both hands free, and holds it straighter than you do.
prongs.sign: Your ward's sign glows on its face like a house mark over a lintel.
prongs.habit: It holds itself dead straight. If the ward on it tilts, it corrects.

finishes.name: Standing Ward
finishes.of: one who can be left in charge
finishes.text: Set down, it is a ward that needs no one to hold it. You left it guarding a door overnight and found the door still there.
finishes.sign: The air a pace in front of it is slightly thick.
finishes.habit: Left alone in a room it does not move. You have come back after a day to check.

finishes.name: Sworn Shield
finishes.of: one who has not stepped aside for anything since a certain day
finishes.text: It took your oath when you did and wears it across the face. It has not stepped aside for anything since.
finishes.sign: A crest across its face that was not there before the oath.
finishes.habit: For some part of every day it faces the direction you swore in.

prongs.name: Grave-door
prongs.of: one who keeps the dead of the house inside the house
prongs.text: It is the right size and shape to close a tomb, and has started to behave like it.
prongs.sign: Stone-grey and cold to the touch, with a ring handle nobody uses.
prongs.habit: In the evening it leans against the hearth wall, and something leans against the other side.

finishes.name: Hearth-board
finishes.of: one who hangs over the family fire and listens
finishes.text: It hangs over the hearth between outings and the shade there talks to it. It comes down knowing an older way to stand.
finishes.sign: Smoke-darkened on one side from hanging over the hearth.
finishes.habit: It hangs itself over the fire between outings. It comes down warm.

finishes.name: Night-gate
finishes.of: one who is the reason nothing came in last night
finishes.text: In a ruin after dark it stands in the one way in. What comes to look at it goes away again.
finishes.sign: It shows no edge against the dark, only a pair of eyes at head height.
finishes.habit: After dark it goes to stand in the one way in, wherever that is.

paths.name: Shelter-shield
paths.of: one who cannot watch it land on someone else
paths.text: It learned from you to count heads, and to tilt toward the one who is not looking.
paths.sign: It is wider than it is tall, and curved like a hand held over something.
paths.habit: It hovers over whoever in the room is smallest or most tired.

prongs.name: Roof-shield
prongs.of: one who holds something over their friends and calls it nothing
prongs.text: It has learned to lie flat overhead. There is room under it for more than you.
prongs.sign: It rides above head height, face down, like a tray carried high.
prongs.habit: In rain it goes to whoever has no hood.

finishes.name: Roof of Shields
finishes.of: one under whom a whole company can sit out a storm
finishes.text: Over a classmate it spreads into a roof, plank by plank. The cohort has sat out two storms and one beast under it.
finishes.sign: Overlapping plates, like tiles, that spread when they are needed.
finishes.habit: It spreads a little whenever two or more of your friends sit down together.

finishes.name: Half-share
finishes.of: one who takes half of whatever lands on a friend
finishes.text: It cannot stop all that reaches your friends, so it takes half. Everyone aches in the morning and nobody mentions it.
finishes.sign: It carries dents that match the bruises of people nearby.
finishes.habit: It presses against whoever is hurting, and is a little duller afterwards.

prongs.name: Road-shield
prongs.of: one who gets other people across
prongs.text: It rides on the outside of whoever you are bringing home, and has opinions about the route.
prongs.sign: It keeps to the outer side of the road, whichever side that is.
prongs.habit: It walks strangers to the gate and comes back.

finishes.name: Passenger's Door
finishes.of: one whose charges arrive without a mark on them
finishes.text: It rides on the side of whoever you were paid to bring home. None of them has arrived with a mark on them.
finishes.sign: A small eye in the boss that watches the passenger, not the road.
finishes.habit: It checks on whoever is asleep in the room, each in turn, like a conductor.

finishes.name: Breakwater
finishes.of: one who stands in the flood so that others can cross behind
finishes.text: It stands in a river in flood and the water goes around. People cross in the slack behind it.
finishes.sign: A green line across its face at the height of the last high water.
finishes.habit: It stands in gutters and streams, upstream of you, for no reason it will give.

prongs.name: Hound-shield
prongs.of: one who draws the danger onto themselves on purpose
prongs.text: On a hunt it goes in front and keeps the beast's attention, the way a good dog does and with about the same manners.
prongs.sign: A ruff of bristle round the rim, and it goes ahead of you with its face low.
prongs.habit: It rattles its boss at anything bigger than itself until the thing looks at it.

finishes.name: Old Acquaintance
finishes.of: one who knows each old enemy's first move
finishes.text: It has stood in front of named beasts often enough to know each one's first move. It is in the way of that move, every time.
finishes.sign: Its scars come in sets. Each set is from the same animal, years apart.
finishes.habit: It shifts its guard in its sleep, the same few shifts, in the same order.

finishes.name: Beater's Shield
finishes.of: one who gets their way by being in everybody's way
finishes.text: It drives a beast as beaters do, by being loud and wide and always on the wrong side. The beast ends up where you wanted.
finishes.sign: It booms when struck, and has learned to strike itself.
finishes.habit: It herds things toward you: chickens, children, a rolling apple.
